upgradeReview.network: New experience diagnostics hooks are inert in this integration. Existing publish/deploy request changes remain behind hidden unsupported UI and unsupported local daemon routes. No remote-host or permission expansion.
upgradeReview.dynamicExecution: The motion source player injects bundled static JavaScript into the existing opaque sandbox. It creates no network client, dynamic code evaluator or external script URL. Snapshot serialization stays in the iframe.
upgradeReview.downloads: Existing parent-owned trusted Save file gate remains after motion/title injection. Export failure-copy changes do not authorize new writes or downloads.
upgradeReview.credentials: New failure-detail parsing only accepts bounded classification tokens; Cindy does not mount the upstream analytics/daemon credential flows. No credentials are introduced.
